what: The index pass that closed ITEM-47. Four targets were declared on 2026-09-02 after the live sweep hit the list view threshold; the 2026-09-03 apply run did not reach them. This run indexes DueDate and Acknowledgement_x0020_Due_x0020_ on Global Tracking Queue and finds Modified already indexed on both lists. No column was created: all 103 specified columns read back present.

source.capture: window.spLedger, exported with copy(JSON.stringify(spLedger, null, 2)) and uploaded by the operator.
source.startedUtcWhyNull: The provisioner prints no timestamp of its own. The date is the operator's session, 2026-09-05.

runs.meaning: The column estate was already complete. This run existed for the index pass, not to create columns, which is why its ledger is empty rather than absent.

ledgerWhyEmpty: No column was created. The gate requires a later run's ledger to name only columns the specification marks PENDING and attributes to that run; a run that created nothing correctly names none.

indexRun.addressing: Each target is addressed by list GUID, not title — the provisioner reads fieldState(siteUrl, listGuid, internalName) before deciding, and skips one already indexed.
indexRun.ledgerDerivation: Taken from the operator's spLedger export, filtered to type === 'index'. The row values are translated to the console vocabulary this directory's records use: the provisioner writes row.result 'created' where it prints 'indexed', and 'present' where it prints 'already indexed'. All nine declared targets appear.
indexRun.closes: ITEM-47. All four targets declared 2026-09-02 now carry an outcome: DueDate and Acknowledgement_x0020_Due_x0020_ created, Modified present on both lists.
indexRun.modifiedWasAlreadyIndexed: Global Tracking Queue.Modified and DGO DIGITAL OPS.Modified read back Indexed before this run. That is an observed outcome, not an assumption — the provisioner reads each field's state first and reported 'present' rather than setting it.
indexRun.verified: Nine targets read, nine outcomes recorded, none FAILED. SharePoint refused nothing, which is not guaranteed on a list over the view threshold and is worth recording as an observation rather than an expectation.

whatThisDoesNotClose: That the scheduled sweep now completes. Indexing is necessary and not sufficient: the sweep's query also had to be bounded to a 30-day window, and one clean hourly run is what proves it (ITEM-45's remaining half).
ITEM-56. The OTP allow-list is a row in Flow Configuration, not an index, and no gate here can read it.

noVerifyRun.why: The operator ran the apply pass only. No second reading was taken after it, so nothing here re-reads the two indexes this run set.
noVerifyRun.whatIsAlreadyEstablishedWithoutIt: That SharePoint accepted both index requests: setIndexed returned ok for DueDate and Acknowledgement_x0020_Due_x0020_, and the provisioner reports a refusal rather than swallowing it — indexing a list already over the view threshold can be refused, and neither was.
noVerifyRun.howItCloses: A DRY_RUN pass of the same script, which would report 9 already indexed and 0 to set. It is one paste and needs no write.
noVerifyRun.doesNotBlock: ITEM-47, whose resolution criterion is that every declared target carries a recorded outcome. Nine do.
